recognize_zh: 淋巴結 H&E 左側為密集小淋巴球的濾泡區，右側可見成片胞質透明、核圓的細胞（單核球樣 B 細胞，monocytoid B cells），並有小群胞質淡嗜酸性的類上皮組織球侵入邊緣，這組合提示弓漿蟲淋巴結炎（toxoplasmosis）。
features: Dense aggregate of small mature lymphocytes on the left (follicle/mantle region)
Sheet of medium-sized cells with abundant clear to pale cytoplasm and round to bean-shaped nuclei on the right, consistent with monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia
Small loose clusters of epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and elongated vesicular nuclei at the interface
No well-formed granulomas, necrosis or multinucleated giant cells in the field
Occasional mitoses and scattered small vessels with red cells
describe_en: Lymph node section shows a dense aggregate of small lymphocytes adjacent to a sheet of monocytoid B cells with abundant clear to pale cytoplasm and round to bean-shaped nuclei. Small loose clusters of epithelioid histiocytes are present, focally encroaching on the lymphoid aggregate. Well-formed granulomas, caseous necrosis and multinucleated giant cells are not identified. These findings are consistent with the triad of toxoplasmic lymphadenitis (follicular hyperplasia, small epithelioid histiocyte clusters and monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia); serologic confirmation is recommended.

ddx.vs: Marginal zone lymphoma shows monotonous monocytoid cells effacing architecture with light chain restriction, rather than reactive follicles with epithelioid clusters.
These form discrete well-formed (sometimes necrotizing) granulomas with giant cells rather than small ill-defined epithelioid clusters.
Cat-scratch disease shows stellate suppurative necrotizing granulomas with neutrophils, which are absent here.
Hodgkin lymphoma contains CD30/CD15-positive Reed-Sternberg or LP cells within the mixed infiltrate.
